frontend.placeholder_policy: Compile-only declarations; no execution or return-type assumptions.
frontend.typing_scope: Evaluate names, attribute paths and collections; dependency-name projection does not claim scalar type equivalence.

set.syntax: {% set name = value %} | {% set name %}...{% endset %}
set.description: Assign a value to a variable within the template. Supports both single-line assignment and block assignment.
set.caveat: Assignments are scoped to the current context. Block assignments capture rendered text, not expressions.

for.syntax: {% for target in iterable %}...{% else %}...{% endfor %}
for.description: Iterate over an iterable (such as a list, tuple, or dict) and render the block for each item.
for.caveat: Loop variables are only available inside the loop body.

extends.description: Declare template inheritance from a parent template. The child template may override blocks defined by the parent.
extends.caveat: The extends tag must appear before any output, except whitespace or comments.

safe.description: Mark a string as safe HTML, disabling auto-escaping.
safe.caveat: Use only with trusted content; improper use can cause XSS vulnerabilities.
